## pressureDropDarcy

`function OpenTEMPEST.Blocks.Functions.pressureDropDarcy`

*Pressure drop in a porous medium from Darcy's law*

Extends from Modelica.Icons.Function (Icon for functions).

**Inputs**

| Name | Description | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| `mf` | Mass flow rate of the fluid | `kg/s` |
| `eta` | Dynamic viscosity of the fluid | `Pa.s` |
| `rho` | Density of the fluid | `kg/m3` |
| `L` | length of flow channel | `m` |
| `A` | Total cross-sectional area of flow channel | `m2` |
| `k` | Permeability of the porous medium in the flow channel | `m2` |

**Outputs**

| Name | Description | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| `dp` | Pressure loss | `Pa` |

## g0_T

`function OpenTEMPEST.Blocks.Functions.g0_T`

*Gibbs energy of a gas at temperature T and standard pressure*

Returns the molar Gibbs energy of a single gas at temperature `T` and standard pressure.

Example:

```
G_h2o = g0_T(T=T, data=Modelica.Media.IdealGases.Common.SingleGasesData.H2O);
```

Extends from Modelica.Icons.Function (Icon for functions).

**Inputs**

| Name | Description | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| `data` | Ideal gas data |  |
| `T` | Temperature | `K` |

**Outputs**

| Name | Description | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| `g` |  | `J/kg` |

[Back to top](#opentempestblocksfunctions)
